faqs.q: How much does Knowtex cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Knowtex offers custom pricing based on team size and requirements. You must contact their sales team for a personalized quote. No publicly listed pricing tiers are available.

faqs.q: What makes Knowtex different from other AI scribes?
faqs.a: Knowtex positions itself as a voice AI platform for workflow automation—not just scribing. It combines note-taking with charge capture and claims to double doctor efficiency through comprehensive workflow automation.
HIPAA compliance status is unknown from public information. US practices should confirm HIPAA compliance and BAA availability directly with Knowtex before implementation.
Knowtex has South African origins and appears to focus on international markets. US practices should verify compliance and data residency requirements.

faqs.q: Knowtex vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Freed ($39-119/mo) has transparent pricing, confirmed HIPAA compliance, and US focus. Knowtex requires custom pricing and sales engagement. For US practices wanting quick signup with known costs, Freed. For enterprise workflow automation with custom implementation, explore Knowtex.
